preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of blocks N in each test case must be between 2 and 1000.
The number of jumps K must be between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: len(S) == N and all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The binary string S must have length N and consist only of '0' and '1' characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the farthest block Chef can reach with exactly K jumps, or -1 if it's not possible.
